notes.title: 🐾 Chowdown Kitty Demo is Here!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We are so excited to share that the [b]Chowdown Kitty Demo[/b] is now live on Steam. Starting today, you can jump in and experience the very first taste of our cozy match 3 cat collecting game.[/p][p]Here is what you will find in the demo:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fast paced match 3 puzzles[/b] with a timed twist

[/p][/*][*][p][b]A starter set of kitties[/b] to collect and add to your lounge

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Accessories and cosmetics[/b] to give each kitty a bit of extra charm

[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Lounge[/b], where your cats come together and show off your growing collection

[/p][/*][/list][p]This demo is just the beginning. We would love for you to try it out, let us know what you think, and share your favorite kitty discoveries with the community. Your feedback will help us shape the best version of Chowdown Kitty for launch.[/p][p]💬 Join the discussion right here in the [u][url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2944590/discussions/1/"]Steam Community Hub[/url][/u]. We will be reading everything, answering questions, and highlighting your feedback.[/p]

notes.title: Chowdown Kitty is Partnering with indie.io – Coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to share some big news: [i]Chowdown Kitty[/i] will be published by [b]indie.io[/b] and is officially on its way to Steam![/p][p]In [i]Chowdown Kitty[/i], your goal is simple but oh-so-addictive: match treats, fill bowls, and welcome hundreds of adorable feline friends into your cozy lounge. Every match brings a little joy (and a lot of purring) as you race against the clock to keep every kitty happily fed.[/p][p][b]What’s in store for you:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Cozy, Fast-Paced Match 3 Fun[/b] – Match tiles to fill bowls and invite adorable kitties to move in.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hundreds of Cats to Collect[/b] – From playful tabbies to majestic fluffballs, each kitty has its own charm.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dress Them Up[/b] – Hats, scarves, and accessories bring even more personality to your feline family.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Lounge[/b] – Your customizable space to relax with your cats and show off your growing collection.

[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Bonus Stages[/b] – Unique challenges and power-ups to keep the fun fresh.

[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re here for the puzzles, the cats, or the joy of watching your lounge fill with furry friends, [i]Chowdown Kitty[/i] will keep you smiling every step of the way.[/p][p][b]Add [i]Chowdown Kitty[/i] to your Wishlist today[/b] so you’ll be the first to know when it’s ready to play![/p]
